description: The app webview's baseline grant. `core:default` is what makes `listen()` work at all — without it the event plugin's commands are denied, every listener registration rejects silently, and a turn runs to completion with nothing on screen. The app owns its title bar; the browser child webview is confined to pane bodies below its drag region and window controls. SCOPED BY `webviews`, NEVER `windows`: a `windows` entry grants every webview in that window, browser pane included, which would hand `window.__TAURI__` to whatever page is loaded. See `src/browser.rs` and the test in it that pins this file.
